summary: The note describes ghost-story traditions and haunted sites in the town of Fairwich, centered on Edward Mallory's September 2023 compendium "Echoes of the Eerie: Ghost Stories of Fairwich." It covers the Grimsley House, Old Willow Cemetery and the Lady in Gray, modern storytelling through media, and a boom in ghost tourism. It argues that these tales remain a core part of regional identity and an ongoing oral tradition.
one_line: Fairwich's haunted houses, cemeteries, and ghost tourism keep its folklore alive, as shown by Edward Mallory's 2023 ghost story compendium.
key_facts: Edward Mallory, a local historian and folklorist, published "Echoes of the Eerie: Ghost Stories of Fairwich" on September 15, 2023.
Mallory's compendium draws on accounts dating back to the 1800s and includes the tale of the Wailing Widow of Wickery Bridge, who laments her betrothed lost to the waters below.

Grimsley House is a Victorian mansion that has stood since October 1883 and is said to be haunted by the Grimsley family, with reports of footsteps, apparitions in period attire, and piano music from the ballroom.
Megan Jacobs, a lifelong Fairwich resident, reported an unexplained encounter at Grimsley House in September 2023, hearing a whisper call her name when no one was there.
Old Willow Cemetery is the resting place of many of Fairwich's earliest settlers and is surrounded by tales of ghostly guardians.
Caretaker Mr. Alistair Crane said in a September 20, 2023 interview that at nightfall there is "a stirring that words can't justly describe."
The "Lady in Gray" is a frequently sighted spectral figure at Old Willow Cemetery, with her face hidden by a cloak hood, said to appear to people carrying heavy burdens.
On September 8, 2023, the Fairwich Times published a survey finding that 67% of the local population believes in the supernatural to some degree.
Jessica Newcomb, host of the podcast "Haunts and Histories," visited Fairwich on September 25, 2023, saying ghost stories speak to our fears, hopes, and understanding of life and death.
Ghost tourism in Fairwich has steadily grown since the turn of the millennium, and ghost tours sell out every year, especially around Halloween.
Phantoms and Pubs, which combines historical pub crawls with ghost stories, had its highest bookings to date in September 2023, according to owner Amelia Barton.
The note opens in late October 2023 with a group gathered outside Grimsley House in Fairwich's old town for ghost tales.
